messages.subject: Repositioning The Side Scroll Bar
parts:
Hey all,

I have a recurring issue where on occasion there will be so many samples in a plot that it stretches the page horizontally, which itself isn't much of a concern.  The problem is that the horizontal scroll bar is only visible when scrolling to the bottom of the page.  So at a glance, it may not be obvious that some of the plots are actually going off the page horizontally.

So the solution I would like to achieve is having the sideways scroll bar always visible if/when the page needs one.

Thanks!
Mike

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Repositioning The Side Scroll Bar
parts:
Looks like Bootstrap's tab panel doesn't want you to let content inside expand the size of the tab panel--that's a reasonable decision on their part I think.

Try adding this somewhere in your sidebarPanel or mainPanel (doesn't matter where):

tags$style(type="text/css", ".tab-content { overflow: visible; }")

If that doesn't work then try this instead:

tags$style(type="text/css", ".tab-content { overflow: visible !important; }")
